item.text: I’ve located the core services and actions. I’m reading those alongside the session, notification, digest, and deletion flows because several reports share the same membership state.

The failures come from several coupled invariants: expiry units and pending filters are wrong, acceptance creates an inactive membership and ignores the invitee identity, and cached seat counts omit invitation lifecycle changes. I’m fixing these at the service/repository boundaries and making removal/deletion update sessions and recipient eligibility.

The main lifecycle paths are updated. I’m checking the action layer for duplicate quota/rate checks that could still reject valid invitations, plus the invitation list and counter queries for consistent pending semantics.
